description.text: The Base Expansion Pack, the first set of the Pokémon Card e series, released on 1 December 2001 with the e Starter Pack. The series was made to work with the Card e-Reader, which reads the dot codes printed along the card edges. Its packs hold five cards: one rare, one uncommon and three commons. The series is set on a mysterious continent, but this first pack does not yet follow that story. Its cards are numbered to 128, and its English counterpart is Expedition Base Set, released in September 2002.
